notes: The three Morgan Stanley labels (BTM equipment TAM, AI-semis-vs-power-shortfall, and the MS portion of data-center capacity) read as one coherent power-shortfall report split into three reader labels; that would publish as one MAIN EVENT with named-winner movements, not three BRIEFS. Header states 126 total cards but only 78 appear under the listed labels, so the share is computed against the stated total, not the visible one.
